PRIVACY_POLICY.title: Privacy policy
PRIVACY_POLICY.body:
MIM Creative Wear: updated policies

Shipping policy

Shopify admin: Settings, Policies, Shipping policy. Select all below, copy, paste over the old text, Save.

Shipping

We ship across Egypt and internationally. Every order is confirmed by email with its order number. Orders placed on weekends or public holidays are processed on the next working day.

Shipping in Egypt (EGP)

  • Cairo and Giza: Standard (2 to 5 working days) 85, free on orders over 2,999. Express (1 to 2 working days) 120.
  • Rest of Egypt (Alexandria, Delta, Canal cities, Upper Egypt, Red Sea, Sinai and Matrouh): Standard (2 to 5 working days) 85. Express (1 to 2 working days) 120.

Shipping outside Egypt (EGP)

  • Orders up to 4,000: 1,200
  • Orders over 4,000: 3,200

International delivery times depend on the destination and are confirmed by email after you order. Any customs duties or import taxes are paid by the customer.

The exact shipping cost is always shown at checkout before you pay.

Payment

Pay by card online, or cash on delivery within Egypt.

Questions

Email mim@mimcreativewear.com or call customer service on +201102220008.

Refund policy

Shopify admin: Settings, Policies, Refund policy. Select all below, copy, paste over the old text, Save.

Exchanges

If you are not happy with your piece, you can exchange it within 2 days of receiving your order.

  • Items must be unworn, unwashed and unused, with all tags and packaging in place.
  • To arrange an exchange, email mim@mimcreativewear.com or call customer service on +201102220008 with your order number.
  • You pay the delivery costs for an exchange.
  • Requests made after 2 days may be declined. If we accept a late exchange, an extra fee of EGP 50 is added to the delivery charge.

Faulty, damaged or wrong items

Every piece is quality checked before it ships. If you receive a piece with a manufacturing fault, damage, or the wrong item or size, tell us within 2 days of delivery at mim@mimcreativewear.com. We will replace it if it is in stock, or refund the price of the item once we receive it back.

Refunds

Approved refunds are issued after we receive and inspect the item, to your original payment method. For cash on delivery orders we will agree the refund method with you.

Not covered

  • Items that have been worn, washed or altered
  • Normal wear and tear
  • Small variations in print, colour or size: every piece is printed by hand, so no two are exactly alike

Privacy policy

Shopify admin: Settings, Policies, Privacy policy. Select all below, copy, paste over the old text, Save.

MIM Creative Wear ("we", "us") runs mimcreativewear.com. This policy explains what personal information we collect and how we use it.

Information we collect

  • Details you give us when you order or contact us: name, email, phone number, delivery and billing address, and order details.
  • Payment details are handled by our payment providers through Shopify's secure checkout. We do not store your full card number.
  • Information collected automatically when you browse: device and browser type, IP address, pages viewed, and cookies.

How we use it

  • To process, deliver and support your orders, including exchanges and refunds
  • To answer your questions
  • To send marketing emails if you subscribe. You can unsubscribe at any time.
  • To understand how our website is used, improve it, and measure and show our ads, using tools such as Google Analytics and Google Ads
  • To prevent fraud and meet legal obligations

Sharing

We share information only with the services that help us run the store: Shopify (our store platform), payment providers, delivery companies, and analytics and advertising partners such as Google. We do not sell your personal information.

Cookies

We use cookies to keep your cart and currency, remember your preferences, and measure site and ad performance. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings. Some parts of the site may not work without them.

Keeping your information

We keep order information for as long as needed for our records, accounting and legal obligations.

Your choices and rights

You can ask to see, correct or delete your personal information by emailing mim@mimcreativewear.com.

Contact

MIM Creative Wear, 3 El Kharta El Gedida, Zahraa Misr El Kadima, Cairo, Egypt. Email mim@mimcreativewear.com. Phone +201222116237.

Terms of service

Shopify admin: Settings, Policies, Terms of service. Select all below, copy, paste over the old text, Save.

Overview

This website is operated by MIM Creative Wear. By using mimcreativewear.com or buying from us, you agree to these terms. Our store runs on Shopify.

Products

Our pieces are made and printed by hand, so prints, colours and measurements can vary slightly from piece to piece and from the photos. We try to show colours as accurately as possible, but your screen may display them differently. Quantities are limited and we may discontinue any product.

Prices and orders

Prices are shown in Egyptian pounds and can change without notice. We may refuse or cancel an order, for example if a product is out of stock or a price was shown in error. If we cancel an order you have paid for, we refund you in full.

Shipping, exchanges and refunds

Shipping is covered by our Shipping policy. Exchanges and refunds are covered by our Refund policy.

Your information

How we handle personal information is explained in our Privacy policy.

Use of the website

You may not use this website for any unlawful purpose, to interfere with its security or operation, or to copy our designs, photos or content without written permission.

Liability

To the extent allowed by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from use of this website or our products. Nothing in these terms limits your rights as a consumer under Egyptian law.

Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of Egypt.

Changes

We may update these terms. The current version is always on this page.

Contact

MIM Creative Wear, 3 El Kharta El Gedida, Zahraa Misr El Kadima, Cairo, Egypt. Email mim@mimcreativewear.com. Phone +201222116237.

REFUND_POLICY.title: Refund policy
REFUND_POLICY.body:
Returns & Exchanges
    • Your satisfaction with your online purchase is our aim. If you are unhappy for any reason, we’ll gladly accept an exchange of an unworn item within 2 days once purchase is received. Items received outside this period may not be accepted. In this case, however, an extra exchange charge of LE 50 will be added to the delivery charge. Items should be in the original condition, unworn, unwashed or used in anyway. All tags and packaging must remain in place. We suggest you try on the items as soon as they are received to ensure you are able to return items within our returns timeframe. Every product we send out is quality controlled, however, if you have received a product with a manufacturing fault we will happily replace it or refund the cost as long as you have notified us upon arrival that the piece is damaged. Please note that wear and tear in the course of normal use is not considered a manufacturing fault. In case of having received a faulty item or a wrong size please e-mail us at mim@mimcreativewear.com to arrange the return. We will replace it, if item is available on stock or refund you upon return. We reserve the right to deny refund of the garment returned if they do not meet the requirements of our Return Policy. .

SHIPPING_POLICY.title: Shipping
SHIPPING_POLICY.body:
Shipping
    • Orders can be shipped worldwide. Delivery takes up to max2 working days to all orders in Cairo, Giza & Alexandria and up to 5 working days to all other destinations in Egypt. Once your order has been placed a confirmation email will be sent to the provided e-mail address. If you do not receive confirmation e-mail, please email us on mim@mimcreativewear.com . Purchases made on weekends and public holidays will be processed on the next business day.
Shipping Costs
  • Shipping within any of the following areas is for EGP 50 Cairo/Giza/ 5th settlement/ 6th of October Shipments to Alexandria EGP 70 For orders in other areas inside Egypt or worldwide, please contact us on mim@mimcreativewear.com
    • Orders & Payments
      • After placing your order and filling in the required information, a confirmation will displayed with your order details and your order number. You will have the option of choosing the method of payment. Either cash on delivery or via Visa.
